messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "your prescriber makes this change, not you"
set: ["your prescriber makes this change, not you", "prescriber", "prescriber will watch how you respond", "do this unless your doctor tells you otherwise", "do not change your dose or stop taking it without talking to your prescriber first", "you and your doctor should decide whether you will take this medicine", "this list is not complete", "talk with your doctor if you think your child is not growing at a normal rate while using this medicine", "you may not notice any change in your symptoms", "extended-release tablets are scored and can be split in half if your prescriber tells you to", "not listed in this medication guide", "you have muscle problems that do not go away even after your doctor has told you to stop taking this medicine", "this does not apply to Tirosint-SOL", "how much acid the stomach makes", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "talk with your doctor about this risk"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
